messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-2 · current p95 ~ 640ms (baseline 85ms), p99 ~ 3.8s · streaming stalls/partial responses observed · auto-alert threshold tripped :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: ack i'm on it. swarming in #eng-oncall-console. grabbing metrics now.

sara_eng: saw the spike ~2:07pm UTC, traces show lots of contbatch queueing + some kv cache thrash. attaching quick histogram: oddlen requests (>=1024 tokens) are queuing behind many short chitchat flows.

noah_sre: confirm from infra graphs: steady CPU on batchers but scheduler queue depth jumped ~x6 at the same time. preemption didn't kick for several tenants.

mike_oncall: key question — is this mixed-seqlen packing amplification or a scheduling fairshare bug?

sara_eng: evidence points to mixed-seqlen amplification. contbatch is grouping big requests causing a few huge batches that block streaming lanes -> stalls. p99 lines up with those large batches finishing.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigations i can try: 1) temporarily reduce max_batch_size on streaming pool from 32 -> 8 2) enable pack_shed=true on contbatch scheduler 3) restart batcher pods in us-west-2 one-by-one to pick up config. any objections?

noah_sre: do it. I'll run rolling restart if you patch config. If restarts needed i'll sequence to avoid capacity hole.

emma_support: flag: two customers reported increased latency and one reported partial streams (timed out). I'll draft a short note once we have ETA and mitigations. @ryan_product FYI customer A on dedicated capacity might be impacted.

mike_oncall: patching config now. command i ran:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/cont-batcher MAX_BATCH_SIZE=8 --overwrite
kubectl -n inference annotate deploy/cont-batcher pack_shed=enabled --overwrite
```

sara_eng: also recommend enabling per-tenant fairshare preempt thresholds to avoid large-tenants monopolizing. quick flag: `SCHED_FAIR_PREEMPT=0.25` for now.

noah_sre: monitoring hooks in place. watching p95/p99 and stream error rate. hooking Grafana alert to this thread.

mike_oncall: starting rolling restart of cont-batcher pods (seq: pod-0 -> pod-1 -> pod-2). will wait 60s between restarts.

incident-bot: Deploy started by mike_oncall: cont-batcher config patch · tracking run id: run-1772223334-1

sara_eng: quick log snippet from cont-batcher before restart:
```
[2026-02-12T14:06:52Z] packer: forming batch size=29 seqlens=[12,16,8,1024,20,1024,1024,6,...] latency=3200ms waiting=3100ms
[2026-02-12T14:06:53Z] kvcache: evict hit=0 miss=124 evict_ops=9
```

noah_sre: pod-0 restart complete. traffic shifted. p95 dropped to ~220ms, p99 still ~1.6s (improving).

mike_oncall: pod-1 restart done. p95 190ms, p99 980ms. streaming stalls reduced, partial stream reports down.

emma_support: customer A confirmed reduced errors, says latency improved but still seeing occasional hiccups. i'm sending interim message: "we've rolled mitigations and expect stability; will follow up with root cause and timeline".

sara_eng: we should follow up with model-level mitigations: recommend enabling sequence-length bucketing for packer so it avoids coalescing >512 tokens with small requests. ticketing a follow-up: PACKER-456.

mike_oncall: I'll keep thread live for 30m, then hand off to next oncall. Current state: p95 ~170ms, p99 ~750ms, stream error rate back to baseline. mitigation steps applied: reduced max_batch_size, pack_shed enabled, rolling restart.

ryan_product: please confirm if any customer SLA windows were violated -> we need to trigger notifications if >5 mins of p99>3s per SLA.

emma_support: checking logs for windows now. preliminary: two 3–6 minute windows for customer A and B between 14:06–14:12 UTC. i'll prepare incident notification.

noah_sre: adding follow-ups: 1) revert MAX_BATCH_SIZE when we have smarter bucketing 2) add metric padlock for contbatch so preemption can't be delayed by KV ops 3) run load replay with synthetic oddlen mix.

mike_oncall: handoff: i'm ending shift in 25m — @sara_eng you'll take on-call after that. summary pinned: mitigations applied, p99 improving, customer notify drafted.

sara_eng: ack taking handoff. will keep runbook open and start PACKER-456.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated · severity=severe (customer-impact) · handlers=[mike_oncall,sara_eng,noah_sre] · run=run-1772223334-1

mike_oncall: closing live mitigation phase, leaving postmortem notes in #postmortems.

emma_support: posting customer notif now. thanks team :heart:
